# FG-REVIEW-0024

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_new_migration_and_a_dependency_change_are_neutral_with_risk_warn` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: この変更には注意が要る点があります（認証・権限、CI やデプロイの設定、依存、新しいマイグレーションなど）。チェック forge/risk を確かめてください。
- en: This change touches something that needs a look (authentication or permissions, CI or deploy configuration, dependencies, a new migration, ...). Read the forge/risk check.
- id: Perubahan ini menyentuh hal yang perlu diperhatikan (autentikasi atau izin, konfigurasi CI atau deploy, dependensi, migrasi baru, dan lain-lain). Baca pemeriksaan forge/risk.

## 原因 (cause)

The check `forge/risk` (M3 X7, plan 04 M-6) found only rules of class `warn` in the diff: authentication / permission code or files by path, CI or deploy configuration, a dependency manifest or lock file, a new migration, a symlink or submodule, an index or object dropped in a migration, a GRANT or REVOKE. The run concludes `neutral`; the merge proceeds as the merge method allows (a `warn` never stops auto-merge), and the warning stays on the commit.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

Open the run: gstn checks list --project <id> --sha <head>. The summary lists each finding by rule and path.

## 対処 (fix)

Nothing to fix: read the finding and make sure the change is intended. `neutral` does not satisfy a required check; a project that requires `forge/risk` needs a head without findings.
